shared_assertions.text: Output is a single index.html file, not multiple files
Page has tab navigation bar with clickable tabs
Mermaid CDN script tag is present
JavaScript re-renders Mermaid on tab switch OR uses visibility-based hiding instead of display:none
No duplicate relationship lines between same entity pair in Mermaid ER diagram
Concern cards have sequential numbers (#1, #2, etc.)
Concern cards toggle reviewed state on click with localStorage persistence
Concerns are categorized as Critical, Important, or Consider
Filter buttons exist for severity levels
Architecture tab has annotated folder structure
Architecture tab has Mermaid module dependency diagram
Architecture tab has pattern cards with What/Why/In practice
Indexes use a proper HTML table with aligned columns, not loose divs
Styling is compact/developer-friendly — small fonts, tight padding, 1px borders over shadows
